Theorem
[Loop theorem] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0200 1. ch31:31.14\group 3-manifold topology

Let $\Sigma \subset \partial M$ be connected and let $N\lhd \pi _1(\Sigma )$. If $\ker (\pi _1(\Sigma )\to \pi _1(M))\setminus N\ne \varnothing $, there is an embedded disk whose boundary lies in $\Sigma $ and represents an element outside $N$.
